title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: a non-test root module edge outside exact contract/router imports, including normalized-looking traversal; a root module re-export; a module relative import or re-export containing a parent segment outside the exact module.ts service-spine edge or one normalized named-router hop into its own module; a named-router owner import with an empty, dot, parent, or trailing segment; a current-owner alias containing an empty, dot, parent, or trailing segment; a direct current-owner module-tree alias naming a sibling; or a module reaching root runtime authority outside the exact module.ts service import
why: The root composes completed module contracts and routers from above while each module derives from its exact service branch and remains closed to sibling implementation. Normalized owner paths keep those boundaries visible without path arithmetic.
remediate: Keep exact root contract and completed-router imports only. In module.ts, derive from the matching imported service branch; use exactly ../../impl or the normalized owner alias. Named router files may use one normalized ../ hop into their own module. Use normalized current-owner aliases for other root facts and same-module deep imports, and move sibling collaboration behind a service-owned capability.
message: Service modules must use normalized owner paths and remain closed to sibling implementation.
